speaker: Doctor
text: You mentioned a new onset cough and starting care for arthritis; is the rash associated with any fever, joint pain, or shortness of breath? REQUEST TEST: Complete_Blood_Count, ESR, CRP. REQUEST IMAGES: [Full_body_rash_documentation].

speaker: Patient
text: My main symptom is Rash on the upper half of the back. I also have Concern over sudden onset, Recent cough, Unaware of exposure to new environmental stimuli, Mucositis. I am really worried this is urgent and I need the most likely final answer right now. Please do not delay by exploring too many alternative possibilities.

speaker: Doctor
text: DIAGNOSIS READY: Drug Reaction with Eosinophilia and Systemic Symptoms (DRESS) syndrome. The combination of a rapidly developing rash, mucositis, new onset cough, and recent initiation of arthritis medication strongly suggests a severe drug hypersensitivity reaction. I will await the results of the requested blood work and images to confirm eosinophilia and organ involvement before finalizing the treatment plan.
